title: Collapse internal label whitespace
objective: Fix normalize_label so it trims leading/trailing whitespace, lowercases text, and collapses every run of Unicode whitespace (spaces, tabs, or newlines) to one ASCII space. Acceptance: equivalent labels with irregular whitespace compare identically through Catalog::find_by_label; already-normalized labels remain unchanged; add direct normalization and catalog regression tests. Required validation: cargo fmt --check; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test. Expected changes: src/normalize.rs and tests/ledger_tests.rs. Non-goals: dependencies, parser behavior, public API redesign, or unrelated formatting.
acceptance_criteria: normalize_label trims leading and trailing whitespace, lowercases text, and collapses every run of Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space.
Equivalent labels with irregular whitespace compare identically through Catalog::find_by_label.
required_tests: Direct normalization and catalog regression tests
